# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.0 makes axis identity explicit throughout interactive comparison, prevents an
accidental self comparison in Pairwise mode, simplifies terminal exact rendering, and
sets a practical closest-zoom boundary. The complete v0.8.9 source remains beside this
release for direct comparison and rollback.

See the [validation record](v0.9.0/VALIDATION.md) for the release acceptance matrix and
the status of checks on this isolated source copy.

## Sequence-aware hover readouts

The plot hover card now writes the selected sequence name on both coordinate lines:

```text
identity 98.06%
x Chr1 15,320,297–15,322,330
y Chr2 15,029,469–15,031,503
```

A Self plot uses one sequence on both axes, so its X and Y lines show the same name. A
Pairwise plot shows its two different selected sequence names. The genomic intervals
retain the existing coordinate formatting and continue to follow the hovered cell.

## Distinct Pairwise selections

Pairwise mode now always compares two different loaded records. When the mode first
opens, X uses the first available record and Y uses the next different record. If a
user chooses the other axis's current record, that other axis moves automatically to
a different record. This prevents an X-equals-Y pairwise state while still allowing a
two-record comparison to swap X/Y orientation in one selection. Self comparisons
remain available through the dedicated Self plot tab, which continues to use a single
selector.

Grid behavior is unchanged: diagonal cells are self comparisons and off-diagonal
cells open a Pairwise plot with the row and column records on different axes.

## Cleaner terminal exact view

Exact cells that do not have supporting k-mer evidence now use the selected plot
background instead of the former gray missing-evidence fill. Because missing evidence
no longer has a separate visible color state, the obsolete bottom-left exact-state key
has also been removed. The **Base** legend remains and continues to identify the
default A, C, G, and T match colors. Image exports continue to describe the visible
match colors for Base, Identity, and Direction views without advertising a separate
gray missing-evidence state.

This is a display change. Canonical k-mer matching, complete-footprint geometry,
missing-value representation, exports of participating cells, and scientific
configuration are otherwise unchanged from v0.8.9.

## 100-bp closest view

Interactive navigation is clamped to a minimum visible genomic span of 100 bp on each
axis. Wheel, keyboard, and other viewport zoom paths share the same boundary, so a
record at least 100 bp long cannot be enlarged beyond a 100-by-100-bp view. A shorter
record naturally remains bounded by its full available length. Exact rendering still
uses base-level samples inside that visible interval.

## Compatibility and rollback

Input parsing, indexed loading, the bundled *Arabidopsis thaliana* example, unified
multi-chromosome annotations, grid ordering, palettes, feature tracks, cursor guides,
and estimator defaults are unchanged from v0.8.9. The preserved
`moddotplot-interactive-0.8.9-source` tree can run at the same time on port 4179 while
this release runs on port 4180.
